title: Kissinger Professor of the Practice of Statecraft and World Order
affiliation: Kissinger Professor of the Practice of Statecraft and World Order
bio: Jake Sullivan is the Kissinger Professor of the Practice of Statecraft and World Order at the Harvard Kennedy School and a Senior Fellow at the Carsey School of Public Policy at the University of New Hampshire. He is also the co-host of The Long Game podcast. From January 2021 to January 2025, he was the 28th Assistant to the President for National Security Affairs (National Security Advisor). In the Obama Administration, he served as National Security Advisor to then-Vice President Biden, Director of the Policy Planning Staff at the U.S.
